title: IELTS Speaking Practice — Original Unofficial Prompts
description: Original practice prompts for Parts 1, 2, and 3. Browser recordings remain on the student's device and are not uploaded.

speaking.instructions: Practise speaking aloud. Part 2 includes one minute of preparation followed by up to two minutes of speaking.

questions.text: What is the busiest part of your usual day? Why?
What is something you recently learned to do? How did you learn it?
Is there a place in your town where you like to spend time? What makes it pleasant?
Describe a useful skill you learned. Say what the skill is, when and how you learned it, who helped you, and explain how you use it now.
Should practical skills be taught at school? Explain your view with an example.
How has online learning changed the way adults develop new skills?
Why might people continue learning after they finish formal education?
